## Summary
- Fixes pipeline YouTube playlist creation when the playlist selector was rendered before `window.AudioRecorderYouTube` was available.
- Re-reads the YouTube helper at click time for refresh/create actions so the "Create new" button can create and select the playlist once helpers are ready.
- Adds a Cypress regression for late YouTube helper availability in the pipeline playlist selector.

Fixes Jhon-Crow/audio-recorder-with-visualization#182

## Reproduction
1. Render a pipeline stage playlist selector before `window.AudioRecorderYouTube` is available.
2. Restore the YouTube helper and click "Create new" with a playlist name.
3. Before this fix, the rendered control could stay inert/disabled and the created playlist was not added to the checkbox selection.

## Tests
- `npm test -- --runTestsByPath tests/YouTubeUploader.test.ts`
- `npm run build`
- `git diff --check`
- `npm run test:e2e -- --spec cypress/e2e/pipeline-mode.cy.js` ran the full pipeline spec: the new playlist regression passed, as did the existing playlist creation case. Three unrelated existing pipeline assertions failed in stage navigation, relative publish dates, and full-album timestamps.
